name: San Pablo

queries.query: San Pablo City Laguna Philippines official cadastral parcel map GIS land records
queries.result: Found the official City Government site, official city Real Property Information System, national Geoportal lot plotter, and an official FOI record for a cadastral-map request. No anonymous city parcel API was established.

queries.result: Search returned the same official City Government/RPIS and DENR Land Management Bureau FOI cadastral-map evidence; no public geometry endpoint or downloadable parcel layer was found.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official city homepage advertises a Real Property Information System, but does not expose parcel geometry or an API in the public page.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: San Pablo City Government, Office of the City Assessor / Land Tax Division
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public site says the service is Coming Soon; terms identify city-owned RPIS. No parcel response was requested.
Employee-only sign-in page; login wall, no access attempted.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Philippine Geoportal / national government geospatial portal
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: national public lot plotting and layer viewer
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current JavaScript exposes public map/layer routes and a lot-plotter workflow, but the location and tie-point API calls returned 401 Unauthorized. It is not evidence of San Pablo parcel coverage.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Land Management Bureau (DENR-LMB), national cadastral custodian
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official FOI page records a successful 2023 request for a San Pablo City cadastral map and an attachment, establishing relevant cadastral-map custody but not an anonymous machine-readable service or current geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: San Pablo City local property records and national cadastral-map custody are evidenced; no anonymous citywide parcel geometry scope verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed
blocker: No safe anonymous San Pablo parcel response with native identity and geometry was verified. City RPIS is Coming Soon, employee RPT is login-gated, Geoportal parcel-related API routes returned 401, and WMS capabilities timed out.
remainingUncertainty: The FOI attachment and authenticated/local systems may contain cadastral material, but no current public machine-readable geometry was established. A zero exact-point hit was not used as an absence claim.
nextStep: Retry the official Geoportal service after recovery and inspect only public geometry-plus-ID responses; separately verify whether the city RPIS publishes a public parcel endpoint when it becomes available.
